title: Dependency Pinning and Vulnerability Management Rules
description: Machine-readable enforcement of ADR-0009 (Strict Dependency Pinning and Automated Vulnerability Management). Applies to all Evolith satellite repositories containing package.json files.
adrTitle: Strict Dependency Pinning and Automated Vulnerability Management

rules.title: No caret (^) range specifiers in package.json
rules.description: Every dependency in package.json (dependencies, devDependencies, peerDependencies, optionalDependencies) MUST use an exact version string. The caret prefix (^) is prohibited. Example: use '18.3.1', not '^18.3.1'.
rules.rationale: ADR-0009 §1: Caret ranges allow automatic minor/patch upgrades during npm install, breaking reproducibility and making CVE introduction unpredictable.
rules.validationQuery: grep -r '"\^' package.json — zero matches expected in any package.json file.
rules.autoFixStrategy: Remove ^ prefix from all dependency versions. Run 'npm install --save-exact' or 'npm pkg set dependencies.<pkg>=<version>' with exact version.

rules.title: No tilde (~) range specifiers in package.json
rules.description: Every dependency in package.json MUST use an exact version string. The tilde prefix (~) is prohibited. Example: use '18.3.1', not '~18.3.1'.
rules.rationale: ADR-0009 §1: Tilde ranges allow automatic patch upgrades, breaking reproducibility in the same way as caret ranges.
rules.validationQuery: grep -r '"~' package.json — zero matches expected in any package.json file.
rules.autoFixStrategy: Remove ~ prefix from all dependency versions. Pin to exact current resolved version from package-lock.json.

rules.title: No wildcard (*) or latest-tag version specifiers
rules.description: Version specifiers using '*', 'latest', 'x', or 'X' wildcards are prohibited. Every package must reference a specific semver string.
rules.rationale: ADR-0009 §1: Wildcard versions resolve to arbitrary latest at install time, making the dependency tree completely non-deterministic.
rules.validationQuery: Verify no dependency value matches: *, latest, x, X, or empty string.

rules.title: package-lock.json (or equivalent) must be committed
rules.description: A lock file (package-lock.json for npm, yarn.lock for Yarn, pnpm-lock.yaml for pnpm) MUST be committed to version control and kept current. The lock file is the source of truth for reproducible builds.
rules.rationale: ADR-0009 §4: CI pipelines must execute 'npm ci' which requires a committed lock file. Without it, npm install resolves fresh versions on every run.
rules.validationQuery: Lock file exists in repository root (or workspace root) and is not in .gitignore.

rules.title: CI pipelines use 'npm ci' not 'npm install'
rules.description: Continuous Integration pipelines MUST use 'npm ci' (clean install) to install dependencies. 'npm install' is prohibited in CI because it may update the lock file and resolve different versions.
rules.rationale: ADR-0009 §4: 'npm ci' installs exactly what the lock file specifies. 'npm install' may silently update packages, defeating the purpose of pinning.
rules.validationQuery: CI workflow files (.github/workflows/*.yml) contain 'npm ci' for dependency installation. No 'npm install' step present in CI dependency installation steps.

rules.title: CI pipeline runs npm audit at high severity level
rules.description: Every PR and main branch CI run MUST execute 'npm audit --audit-level=high'. Any High or Critical CVE causes an immediate build failure and blocks merge.
rules.rationale: ADR-0009 §3: Zero-Tolerance CI check for High/Critical vulnerabilities is the primary automated security gate.
rules.validationQuery: CI workflow includes 'npm audit --audit-level=high' or equivalent. Build fails when exit code is non-zero.

rules.title: Zero High or Critical CVEs in production dependencies
rules.description: No High or Critical CVEs may be present in the production dependency tree at time of merge to main or at release. Medium CVEs require documented justification.
rules.rationale: ADR-0009 §3 and quality-thresholds QT-03: Zero High/Critical CVE tolerance in production releases. This rule is consistent with the cross-cutting security threshold.

rules.title: npm overrides entries must be documented with CVE reference
rules.description: When the 'overrides' field in package.json is used to force a transitive dependency to a safe version, each override entry MUST include a comment or corresponding entry in a companion overrides-rationale.json documenting the CVE or reason for the override.
rules.rationale: Overrides are a powerful escape hatch that can mask dependency resolution issues if undocumented. Each override should be traceable to a specific security finding or compatibility requirement.
rules.validationQuery: If package.json contains an 'overrides' section, each override key corresponds to a documented rationale. Check CHANGELOG.md, PR description, or companion overrides-rationale.json.

rules.title: Automated dependency update bot configured
rules.description: Repositories SHOULD have Dependabot or Renovate configured to propose dependency bump PRs automatically. This ensures managed incremental upgrades rather than accumulated drift.
rules.rationale: ADR-0009 §2: Automated bot policy is required for sustainable maintenance of exact-pinned dependencies. Without it, pins become stale security liabilities.
rules.validationQuery: File .github/dependabot.yml or .renovaterc.json (or equivalent) exists and is configured for the npm ecosystem.

rules.title: Workspaces inherit the exact-version policy
rules.description: In monorepos using npm workspaces, Yarn workspaces, or pnpm workspaces, the exact-version policy (no ^ or ~) applies to ALL workspace package.json files, not just the root package.json.
rules.rationale: ADR-0009 §1 applies universally. Workspace packages that use ranges introduce non-determinism even when the root is pinned.
rules.validationQuery: All package.json files in workspace packages (not just root) are free of ^ and ~ prefixes.

waiverPolicy.description: A waiver may be used only when the organization deliberately accepts a temporary deviation from the pinning or audit policy.

exceptions.cves: High/Critical CVEs cannot be waived in production releases without explicit Executive Risk Acceptance. Medium CVEs require documented justification with remediation timeline.
exceptions.ranges: Range specifiers (^ or ~) cannot be used in production package.json files. peerDependencies in published libraries may use ranges by exception with Architecture Board approval.

exitCriteria.description: All MUST rules must pass. SHOULD rules are strongly recommended but advisory. A dependency-pinning violation BLOCKS merge to main.
validationTools: grep for ^ and ~ in package.json files
